verse.text: Teach them to your children. Talk about them when you are at home and when you are on the road, when you are going to bed and when you are getting up.

reflection: Deuteronomy 11:19 isn't asking dads to schedule a weekly 'family devotion' and call it done—it's asking us to weave God's truth into the ordinary moments: the car ride, the bedtime tuck-in, the breakfast table. Your kids are watching how you talk about God far more than they're listening to a formal lesson, so let your faith show up in the small, unscripted conversations of an average Tuesday. That's how it sticks.
